card.text: Ultra-hot giant JWST watched for a whole orbit: day side near 2,760 K, night side near 1,000 K.

sources.label: Mikal-Evans et al. 2023
sources.quote: nightside emission ratios translate to planetary brightness temperatures of 926 ± 12 K (NRS1) and 1,122 ± 10 K (NRS2)

introduction.text: WASP-121b circles its star in 31 hours. JWST's full orbit finds its hottest point just east of noon and a night side cool enough for clouds.

sources.label: Mikal-Evans et al. 2023
sources.quote: consistent with the strongest dayside emission emanating from eastward of the substellar point

temperature-nrs1.summary: Heat from JWST’s whole-orbit light curve in two bands. Grey is where the fitted map gives no temperature.
